# Quote a multi-device backflow test job in seconds

> Free backflow-preventer test fee calculator: per-device test fee with a multi-device discount, a per-device report-filing fee, a travel fee, and a retest fee for failed devices. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
